governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust. No row here is an active capability; each must pass the seeder's gap/lift screen, then human/eval gates, before any promotion. Source URLs are as reported by search/fetch on 2026-06-19; licenses confirmed via WebFetch where the verify_note says so, otherwise carried as 'unknown'. serves_truth=false for everything downstream.

candidates.intent: Compute driving/walking/cycling directions between addresses with live traffic via the Google Routes API.
candidates.input_contract: origin and destination (address or lat/lng) plus optional travel mode and waypoints
candidates.output_contract: route legs with distance, duration, and turn-by-turn steps
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare LLM cannot compute real road routes, current travel times, or traffic-aware ETAs.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a live Google Routes API call (with geocoding) returning real distances and step-by-step directions.
candidates.verify_note: License not confirmed on repo page; requires a Google Maps API key (paid beyond free tier).

candidates.intent: Search Google Maps Places for businesses and points of interest near a location.
candidates.input_contract: text query plus optional location bias and radius
candidates.output_contract: ranked place records with name, address, rating, and place_id
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate real, currently-open businesses with verified addresses and ratings.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds 18 Google Maps tools (places search, geocoding, directions) returning real place records.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on listing; requires Google Maps API key.

candidates.intent: Provide combined geocoding, place search, routing, weather, and environmental data over Google Maps Platform.
candidates.input_contract: location query and tool selection
candidates.output_contract: structured geospatial/environmental records per tool
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model lacks live access to maps, place data, and environmental layers needed for trip/location planning.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds 14 Google Maps tools spanning location services, visual mapping, weather, and environmental info.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; Google Maps API key required; verify per-API quota terms.

candidates.intent: Convert addresses to coordinates and coordinates to addresses via the Mapbox Geocoding v6 API.
candidates.input_contract: an address string or lat/lng pair
candidates.output_contract: geocoded coordinates or a formatted address with detail level
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve real addresses to precise coordinates or reverse-geocode points.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official Mapbox forward/reverse geocoding tool returning real coordinates and place names.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT and official-Mapbox status confirmed via WebFetch; requires a Mapbox access token.

candidates.intent: Compute the area reachable within a given travel time/distance from a point (isochrone).
candidates.input_contract: origin coordinates, travel profile, and time/distance bands
candidates.output_contract: isochrone polygon(s) for the reachable area
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Reachability analysis requires real road-network computation a model cannot perform.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official Mapbox Isochrone API returning real reachability polygons by mode.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch; requires a Mapbox access token.

candidates.intent: Compute a many-to-many matrix of travel times and distances between multiple points.
candidates.input_contract: a set of coordinate pairs and a travel profile
candidates.output_contract: a duration/distance matrix between all origin-destination pairs
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot compute pairwise road travel times across many locations.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official Mapbox Matrix API returning a real travel-time/distance matrix.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch; requires a Mapbox access token.

candidates.intent: Optimize the visiting order of multiple stops (traveling-salesman-style) for an efficient route.
candidates.input_contract: a list of stop coordinates and a travel profile
candidates.output_contract: an ordered route minimizing travel time/distance
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Multi-stop route optimization is a combinatorial problem a model cannot solve reliably.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official Mapbox Optimization API returning an optimal stop ordering.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch; requires a Mapbox access token.

candidates.intent: Perform offline geospatial geometry (distance, point-in-polygon, bearing, centroid, area, bbox, buffer) with no API call.
candidates.input_contract: coordinates/geometry and the operation
candidates.output_contract: the computed geometric result
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models make arithmetic and geometry errors on spherical/geo computations.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds 8 deterministic offline turf-style geometry tools requiring no token.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch; these tools need no Mapbox token.

candidates.intent: Geocode and reverse-geocode using the free OpenStreetMap Nominatim service.
candidates.input_contract: an address string or lat/lng pair
candidates.output_contract: matched coordinates or a structured address
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve addresses against the live OSM database or guarantee real coordinates.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a no-API-key Nominatim geocoding call (rate-limited, UA-identified) returning real OSM results.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT, no-API-key, Nominatim/Overpass/OSRM backends confirmed via WebFetch; respect OSM usage policy.

candidates.intent: Find nearby points of interest by category (schools, parking, EV charging) from OpenStreetMap.
candidates.input_contract: a location and POI category/radius
candidates.output_contract: a list of matching OSM POIs with coordinates and tags
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate real nearby POIs with current coordinates and tags.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Overpass-backed POI search (incl. EV charging along a route) returning real OSM records.
candidates.verify_note: Part of the 25-tool osmmcp set; license MIT confirmed via WebFetch.

candidates.intent: Compute a route between locations across transport modes using the open OSRM engine.
candidates.input_contract: origin and destination coordinates plus mode
candidates.output_contract: route geometry with distance, duration, and turn-by-turn steps
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot compute real road routing over the OSM network.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds OSRM-backed routing returning real geometry and turn-by-turn directions, no API key.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT, OSRM backend confirmed via WebFetch.

candidates.intent: Provide geocoding and location-based services for LLM apps over OpenStreetMap.
candidates.input_contract: a location query
candidates.output_contract: geocoded results and location metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model lacks live geospatial lookups against OSM data.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a Python OSM MCP server exposing geocoding and location services to the model.
candidates.verify_note: License not confirmed; overlaps NERVsystems/osmmcp — keep one after dedupe.

candidates.intent: Fetch current conditions and multi-day weather forecasts for any global location.
candidates.input_contract: a location (coordinates or place name) and optional horizon
candidates.output_contract: current conditions and a daily/hourly forecast with units
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no live meteorological data and cannot produce a real current forecast.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds NOAA + Open-Meteo forecast retrieval (get_forecast/get_current_conditions) returning real data.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT and no-API-key (NOAA+Open-Meteo) confirmed via WebFetch; 12 tools total.

candidates.intent: Retrieve active US weather warnings, watches, and advisories.
candidates.input_contract: a US location or region
candidates.output_contract: active alert records with severity, area, and effective times
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Weather alerts are real-time events a model cannot know or enumerate.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the NOAA-backed get_alerts tool returning real, current US alerts.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch; US-only per NOAA coverage.

candidates.intent: Retrieve historical weather observations from 1940 to present for a location.
candidates.input_contract: a location and a past date range
candidates.output_contract: historical weather time-series with units
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot recall exact historical weather values for arbitrary dates/places.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Open-Meteo ERA5 archive retrieval (get_historical_weather) returning real series.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch.

candidates.intent: Fetch current and forecast air-quality / AQI and pollutant levels for a location.
candidates.input_contract: a location (coordinates or place)
candidates.output_contract: AQI and pollutant concentrations with units
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Air-quality readings are live sensor data unavailable to a model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the get_air_quality tool returning real pollutant/AQI values.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch.

candidates.intent: Fetch ocean wave height, swell, and current conditions for marine locations.
candidates.input_contract: marine coordinates and forecast horizon
candidates.output_contract: wave/swell/current values with units
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Marine conditions are live observations/forecasts beyond model knowledge.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the get_marine_conditions tool returning real marine data.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch.

candidates.intent: Provide complete Open-Meteo access incl. forecasts, ERA5 history, air quality, marine, elevation, and geocoding.
candidates.input_contract: a location plus the Open-Meteo endpoint/parameters
candidates.output_contract: the requested weather/geo time-series with units
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot query the live Open-Meteo APIs or guarantee real values/timestamps.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds broad, no-API-key Open-Meteo coverage (forecast, archive, air-quality, marine, elevation, geocoding).
candidates.verify_note: License not confirmed on README; Open-Meteo is key-free; overlaps weather-mcp — dedupe on import.

candidates.intent: Track flights and retrieve aviation data via the FlightAware AeroAPI.
candidates.input_contract: a flight identifier, route, or airport
candidates.output_contract: flight status, position, and schedule records
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Live flight positions and statuses are real-time data a model cannot access.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds AeroAPI-backed flight tracking returning real flight status/position.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; requires a paid FlightAware AeroAPI subscription.

candidates.intent: Track flights in real time using Flightradar24 data.
candidates.input_contract: a flight number, callsign, or area
candidates.output_contract: live flight records with position and status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Real-time aircraft positions are not in a model's weights.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Flightradar24-backed live flight tracking to the model.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; verify Flightradar24 data-access terms before use.

candidates.intent: Provide live flight tracking, airport METAR/TAF weather, and airline info from open aviation sources.
candidates.input_contract: an aircraft, airport, or area query
candidates.output_contract: flight positions, METAR/TAF, and airport/airline records
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot return live ADS-B positions or current airport weather.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds OpenSky/AviationWeather.gov-backed flight + airport-weather retrieval.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; uses OpenSky Network + AviationWeather.gov + AirLabs.

candidates.intent: Query public-transit next-arrivals, alerts, and live vehicle positions from GTFS / GTFS-RT feeds.
candidates.input_contract: a transit stop/route and a GTFS feed config
candidates.output_contract: upcoming arrivals, service alerts, and vehicle positions
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Transit schedules and real-time positions are live feed data a model cannot enumerate.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds GTFS static + GTFS-RT querying (arrivals/alerts/vehicles) for any GTFS agency.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch; does NOT do trip planning (retrieval only).

candidates.intent: Validate an email address's format, domain, and deliverability.
candidates.input_contract: an email address string
candidates.output_contract: validity, deliverability, and risk signals
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot perform live MX/SMTP checks to know if an email is deliverable.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds AbstractAPI-backed email validation returning real format/domain/deliverability results.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo; requires an AbstractAPI key (ABSTRACT_API_KEY).

candidates.intent: Preview, audit, and check email-template deliverability and rendering across many email clients.
candidates.input_contract: an email HTML template
candidates.output_contract: preview/audit findings, diffs, and deliverability checks per client
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot render an email across 15 clients or run real deliverability/spam checks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds rendering, auditing, and deliverability checks across email clients.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; rendering/audit deterministic, spam-scoring partly heuristic.

candidates.intent: Validate and look up carrier/line-type/owner metadata for a phone number (Twilio Lookup).
candidates.input_contract: a phone number in E.164 form
candidates.output_contract: validity, carrier, line type, and country metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot validate a live phone number or resolve its carrier/line type.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Twilio Lookup over the official MCP (1,800+ endpoints incl. Lookup) returning real carrier data.
candidates.verify_note: Official Twilio MCP exposes Lookup/Verify; license per Twilio terms; requires Twilio credentials (paid).

candidates.intent: Send and check one-time-passcode verifications to confirm possession of a phone number (Twilio Verify).
candidates.input_contract: a phone number and a submitted verification code
candidates.output_contract: verification start status and approved/denied result
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot send an SMS/voice OTP or verify possession of a device.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Twilio Verify start/check over the official MCP returning real verification results.
candidates.verify_note: Official Twilio MCP exposes Verify; license per Twilio terms; requires Twilio credentials (paid).

candidates.intent: Send SMS text messages programmatically via Twilio.
candidates.input_contract: a destination number and message body
candidates.output_contract: message SID and delivery status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot dispatch a real SMS or obtain a delivery receipt on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an authenticated Twilio SMS-send tool returning a real message SID/status.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; requires Twilio credentials (paid).

candidates.intent: Perform a WHOIS lookup for a domain and return registration details.
candidates.input_contract: a domain name
candidates.output_contract: registrar, registrant, creation/expiry dates, and name servers
candidates.gap_hypothesis: WHOIS records are live registry data a model cannot reliably recall and often fabricates.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a real WHOIS query returning registrar, dates, and name-server records.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page.

candidates.intent: Research a domain: WHOIS, DNS records, SSL certs, domain age, and expired-domain checks.
candidates.input_contract: a domain name (or list for bulk)
candidates.output_contract: combined WHOIS/DNS/SSL/age records
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot fetch live DNS/SSL/WHOIS state or determine current domain availability.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds no-API-key domain research (WHOIS, DNS, SSL, age, bulk) returning real records.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; README states no API keys needed.

candidates.intent: Run DNS lookups, WHOIS, connectivity tests, and TLS certificate analysis on a host.
candidates.input_contract: a hostname or domain plus the diagnostic type
candidates.output_contract: DNS records, WHOIS, reachability, and TLS cert details
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve DNS, test connectivity, or inspect a live TLS certificate.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic network diagnostics (DNS, WHOIS, TLS, HTTP monitoring) over real hosts.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; repo is mcp-netutils (a.k.a. mcp-domaintools).

candidates.intent: Check whether a domain name is available to register across many TLDs.
candidates.input_contract: a domain or base name and TLD list
candidates.output_contract: availability status per TLD with DNS/WHOIS verification
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Registration availability is live registry state a model cannot know.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds DNS/WHOIS-verified availability checks across 50+ TLDs with bulk support.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; zero-clone uvx install per repo.

candidates.intent: Resolve an IP address to country/city, network/ASN, and proxy/VPN signals.
candidates.input_contract: an IPv4/IPv6 address
candidates.output_contract: geolocation, ASN/ISP, and privacy (VPN/proxy) flags
candidates.gap_hypothesis: IP-to-location and VPN/proxy detection require a live database a model lacks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds IPLocate.io-backed geolocation, ASN, and proxy/VPN detection returning real data.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; published by IPLocate; verify free-tier limits.

candidates.intent: Check an IP address's abuse-confidence score and report history (AbuseIPDB).
candidates.input_contract: an IP address (or CIDR block)
candidates.output_contract: abuse confidence score and report metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: IP reputation is live threat-intel data outside a model's knowledge.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds AbuseIPDB-backed reputation lookups returning real confidence scores and reports.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; requires an AbuseIPDB API key.

candidates.intent: Screen a name/entity against OFAC SDN, EU, UK OFSI, UN, and OpenSanctions watchlists.
candidates.input_contract: a person/entity name and optional identifiers
candidates.output_contract: matched watchlist entries with scores and list source
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Sanctions lists update frequently and a model cannot reliably enumerate or match against them.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds in-memory, self-hosted screening against official OFAC/EU/UK/UN/OpenSanctions lists via an /mcp endpoint.
candidates.verify_note: License Apache-2.0, MCP /mcp endpoint, no external DB required — all confirmed via WebFetch; fuzzy match needs threshold review.

candidates.intent: Screen individuals, companies, crypto wallets, vessels, and aircraft against sanctions and PEP categories.
candidates.input_contract: an entity name/identifier and entity type
candidates.output_contract: matches across Sanctions and PEP levels with categories
candidates.gap_hypothesis: PEP/sanctions exposure across non-person entity types is specialized live data a model lacks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds AML Watcher API screening across many entity types and PEP levels 1-4.
candidates.verify_note: License NOT stated on repo (WebFetch); requires an AML Watcher API key (paid).

candidates.intent: Screen individuals/organizations against OFAC SDN, UN, OFSI and produce a risk assessment.
candidates.input_contract: a name and optional identifiers
candidates.output_contract: sanctions matches and a structured risk score
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot match against current consolidated sanctions lists or compute defensible risk.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds OFAC-API-backed screening returning real matches and risk assessments.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; uses a third-party OFAC API (verify terms).

candidates.intent: Run counterparty due diligence combining business-registry identity with EU+OFAC sanctions and insolvency checks.
candidates.input_contract: a company/person identifier and jurisdiction
candidates.output_contract: a due-diligence report with identity, sanctions, and insolvency findings
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Cross-source due diligence needs current registry, sanctions, and insolvency data a model lacks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a unified aggregator over ARES identity + EU/OFAC sanctions + ISIR insolvency (Czech-focused).
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; jurisdiction skews Czech/EU; open-source per listing.

candidates.intent: Search UK companies and retrieve profiles, officers, filings, charges, and ownership (PSC).

candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds UK Companies House API access returning real company, officer, filing, and PSC records.
candidates.verify_note: License not confirmed on listing; requires a free Companies House API key.

candidates.intent: Query the Norwegian Business Registry (BRREG) for companies, subsidiaries, and board members.
candidates.input_contract: an org number or company name
candidates.output_contract: organizational data, subsidiaries, and board members

candidates.verify_note: License unverified; source URL is a Glama listing (no direct GitHub confirmed).

candidates.intent: Validate and standardize a US mailing address against the official USPS API.

candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds 20 Smarty tools (US/international verification, enrichment, geo, postal codes) over real data.
candidates.verify_note: Vendor-hosted MCP; license per Smarty terms; requires Smarty Auth-Id/Auth-Token (paid).

candidates.intent: Convert text to natural-sounding speech audio.

candidates.output_contract: a generated speech audio file

candidates.input_contract: a text prompt and SD parameters
